All still hold; the doc makes no claim about per-chat draft restore (useChatInput) and its 'snapshot activity remains a synchronous publisher' sentence is unaffected by the async outbox settle added in snapshotHandlers.ts. No edit.

Checked every branch-added sentence against useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts, outboundQueue.ts (`reconcile`, `OutboundLookupPausedError`, `completeAcceptedTurnsNotOpen`), useOutboundQueueFlush.ts (`current()`, `changedWhileFlushing`/`handled`, send-only), outboundQueueProjection.ts, outboundQueueReporting.ts, snapshotHandlers.ts, useChatInput.ts and chat-drafts-store.ts (20,000 cap). Four sentences corrected (paired-Station exception to the device-refusal rule, paused-lookup wording, which windows miss the terminal, what makes a chat read queued); the rest match, including the draft-restore, replay-leaves-composer, Discard-as-not-sent, one-further-pass and outage-notice sentences. No edit.

Also checked `useSendMessage()` (first four arguments, 'can queue or refuse'), `queueExecutionMessage` 'takes no approval pick', `getTurnDelivery` and the skill-experience attachment-role mapping against the sender and foregroundMessageDispatch.ts. No edit.

Compared 'saves a text message before sending ... keeps the saved draft', the delivery-line list, 'Discard… ... in the queued-message notice ... only after I checked, discard it' and the Saved drafts paragraph against the sender (live row, 3 s bound, notice still carries the confirm even when it discards as not-sent), MessageDeliveryNote/deliveryLabels and chat-drafts-store.ts; the 'restoring replaces the destination composer' sentence is the explicit Saved drafts pick, not the per-chat restore that useChatInput.ts now limits to an empty composer. No edit.
